stylists.bio: Samantha Marie runs Beauty By Samiie, a relaxing home-based salon in Richmond, TX. From hair, color, and fades to nails, waxing, and bridal styling, she offers quality services with flexible booking — and all are welcome. Self care looks good on you! Follow and book on Instagram or TikTok @beautybysamiie.
